definition: A shortcut connection that adds a layer's input directly to its output, helping gradients flow through very deep networks.
details: Residual (or 'skip') connections, popularized by ResNet, are a core building block of transformer layers and make it feasible to train networks with dozens or hundreds of layers.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Think of it this way: A shortcut connection that adds a layer's input directly to its output, helping gradients flow through very deep networks. And here is the clever part: Residual (or 'skip') connections, popularized by ResNet, are a core building block of transformer layers and make it feasible to train networks with dozens or hundreds of layers. The shape of the machine is half the idea. And that shape of the machine — Residual Connection — is what makes everything else possible.

citation.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
